content.description:
We want to expose the ETH network/community to a new opportunity in NFTs with more affordable transaction cost to maximize the equity in our sector. For this reason, Angel Baby Hit Squad (ABHS) was born. We are launching the initial collection of our NFTs on Ethereum, but providing the future Utility & Airdrops on the Cardano (ADA) network.

We want to maximize fairness, thus there will be no bonding curves and every NFT will cost 0.0777 ETH. No more, no less. There will, of course, be a gas fee associated. This is the cost to transact on the ETH network.

RaritiesEvery Angel is Unique but some attributes will be more rare than others, a full rarity list will be released before our drop, as well as being released to raritysniper.com. There will be 7 “ultimate” pulls with completely unique attributes and utility.

AirdropsAll airdrops will be done on the ADA network. There is no need to port over your NFT from ETH, just create an NFT supported Cardano wallet (i.e. Nami, eternl.io, Daedalus). Then connect your wallets using Lovelink in #official-links of our discord (if you have a hardware ETH wallet just message in our discord for the backup form).

0.5% of royalties will be given to a different charity every month, we call these “Blessings”
